The workbook generation failed to populate specific cells in the 'Task' sheet, resulting in 'None' values where numeric data was expected.
The test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats tests failed with multiple AssertionErrors. Specifically, cells in ranges H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of the expected float values. For example, H12 expected 612.5 but got None, and H35 expected 4.499999999999997 but got None. Ensure the logic for writing values to the 'Task' worksheet correctly maps to these specific row/column coordinates.
